objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and related document records.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected for a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to the document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for relevant IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for relevant companies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for areas of validity.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status metadata associated with a document and its workflow or lifecycle.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute identifying the author with personal authorization.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute identifying reviewers with personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute identifying releasers with personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser_incl._translation
attributes.description: Attribute identifying releasers including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate extended validity.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute affecting e-mail notification distribution for the next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute affecting acknowledgement workflow distribution for the next released version.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version used before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader sees a released language version.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for limited departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template definable for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New object attached in the system to create documents, additional information, attachments, or requests.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing source format used to open a document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted PDF version displayed on the web after saving a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose in document properties.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for a document.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Group- and person-related authorization assigned for documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for system roles, reader assignment, distribution, and authorization.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual person assigned personal authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user participating in roles, workflows, dashboards, and notifications.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System or license role implemented to provide users appropriate functions.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status passed through with the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Versioning information of the attachment.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Validity shared with the main document when released.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object used to supplement documents with additional information, released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Additional relevant equipment or document attachment mentioned as supplementing a document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to an existing document, belonging clearly to a document and managed in the document cockpit.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a change proposal is completed or planned for implementation.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process for release, validity extension, override, acknowledgement, translation, or reactivation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and shown via notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for released versions.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Individual participant signature documented in the system for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow status, proposals, distribution, acknowledgements, or validity processes.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of user groups and persons to document distribution for read authorization, e-mail information, acknowledgement, and dashboards.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing user groups and persons assigned to distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in reports listing acknowledgements.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard displaying relevant documents and information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter influencing report evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion used to filter report result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light
attributes.description: Traffic light display indicating status based on validity or workflow timing.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated in status reports.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-dependent version of a released document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be linked in database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be linked in database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be linked in database integration.
